item.tib: brnag pa las kyi drwa ba 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las phyi bsgrub lha brgyad rtsa ba'i gtso 'khor gyi bsgrub pa
item.coloph: 'chi med gtsug phud kyi lung don/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i brnag pa/ stag la me 'bar gyi thugs dam/ lha klu mi gsum gyis bsgrags pa/ nam mkha' snang mdog thugs kyi bcud du gsungs pa'o/ gshin rje lha brgyad gtso 'khor gyi bsgrubs pa'o/ lung don rgyas pa'i man ngag bla dran pa nam mkhas/ stang dmu tsa gyer med la gdams pa'o/ /
